official: 足立区行政委員会の委員及び非常勤の監査委員の報酬及び費用弁償に関する条例の一部を改正する条例

sources.label: 令和8年第1回定例会 議案一覧

name: 行政委員などの報酬額を改定
summary: 条例では、行政委員会の委員などの報酬額と、公務に伴う費用の弁償項目を定めています。この議案で各委員の報酬額を改定し、費用弁償の項目も変更します。報酬額の改定は2025年4月1日から適用され、費用弁償の項目の変更は2026年4月1日から施行されます。
changes: 教育委員の報酬を月額232,000円から239,900円に上げる
選挙管理委員会の委員長を月額290,000円から299,900円に、委員を232,000円から239,900円に、補充員を5,000円から5,200円に上げる
識見選出の監査委員を月額304,000円から314,300円に、議員選出の監査委員を137,000円から158,200円に、農業委員会の会長を94,000円から97,200円に、委員を47,000円から48,600円に上げる
費用弁償の対象となる交通費や宿泊費などの項目を変更する
why: 行政委員会の委員と非常勤の監査委員の報酬額を改定し、規定を整えるためと、区長は説明しています。

en.name: Revises pay for administrative committee members and others
en.official: Ordinance Partially Amending the Ordinance on Remuneration and Expense Reimbursement for Members of the Adachi City Administrative Committees and Part-Time Audit Committee Members
en.summary: The ordinance sets the pay for members of administrative committees and others, as well as the types of expenses reimbursed for official duties. This bill revises the pay for each committee member and changes the types of reimbursable expenses. The pay revisions apply from April 1, 2025, and the changes to reimbursable expense types take effect on April 1, 2026.
changes: Raises the monthly pay for Board of Education members from ¥232,000 to ¥239,900
Raises the monthly pay for the chair of the election management committee from ¥290,000 to ¥299,900, for committee members from ¥232,000 to ¥239,900, and for alternate members from ¥5,000 to ¥5,200

Raises the monthly pay for audit committee members selected for their expertise from ¥304,000 to ¥314,300, for audit committee members selected from among the assembly members from ¥137,000 to ¥158,200, for the chair of the agricultural committee from ¥94,000 to ¥97,200, and for its members from ¥47,000 to ¥48,600
Changes the types of travel, accommodation, and other expenses eligible for reimbursement
en.why: The mayor says this is to revise the pay for members of administrative committees and part-time audit committee members, and to bring the rules into line.
